subject: Momentum booster: combined credit & discount request — Aurora Ops
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Request: combined credits + first-year discount for Aurora Ops (pilot -> commit path)

Laura —

Quick ask for exec exception sign-off on Aurora Ops. They’re one of the top pipeline opportunities for Q1 (SI: $450k ARR if we convert after pilot). Conversation summary and ask below:

- Customer: Aurora Ops (edge monitoring / industrial telemetry)
- Pilot scope: 6-month pilot, ~75k inference tokens/mo average, spiky bursts for on-prem connectors during ingest.
- Ask: $80,000 in free platform credits to cover pilot surge + a 30% first-year subscription discount conditioned on a 12-month committed renewal after pilot.
- Rationale: Pilot will accelerate integration with two of their Amazon manufacturing customers already committed to an internal PoC. They require SSO, data retention alignment, plus an enterprise SOW that references our private deployment checklist (attached).
- Constraints: Procurement wants written approval by Fri 27 Nov to meet their Q4 budgeting.

Attachments: Aurora_Ops_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW with security addendum), aurora_usage_report_nov.csv (their estimated token usage).

Why this matters: If we win Aurora Ops they have a pipeline of 3 customers that tend to expand quickly; engineering resources already prioritized for the integration. The credit + discount combo is sized to remove friction for procurement and make the post-pilot commit attractive.

Recommended approval motion: Approve $80k credit + 30% off list for first 12 months post-pilot; require standard post-pilot adoption milestones (>=50% of projected token usage and signed renewal) for discounts to apply. If approved I’ll send a canary SOW to Claire and loop Solutions.

Can you sign off or route? Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0133
From: Claire Ramos <claire@aurora-ops.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: combined credits + first-year discount for Aurora Ops (pilot -> commit path)

Ben —

Thanks for the clear proposal. Procurement is pushing us to have financial terms agreed before EOW so we can include the pilot cost in our vendor slate. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The $80k credit should cover estimated spikes for months 2–3 when we onboard two customers.
- We need the option to extend the pilot by one month with a prorated credit drawdown if integration delays occur.
- Can you confirm that any discount is only for Redwood-managed billing (not reseller channels)?

We’re prepared to sign a pilot SOW by 30 Nov if the terms are approved — Claire

--
Claire Ramos
Head of Platform Partnerships, Aurora Ops
claire@aurora-ops.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: combined credits + first-year discount for Aurora Ops (pilot -> commit path)

Looping you in — Ben laid out the ask below and Claire from Aurora confirmed procurement timing.

Marissa — I’d like an exec-level blessing to proceed with the proposed structure but with a couple of tightened conditions: 

1) Credit draw schedule: $50k upfront, $20k released after month 2 subject to integration sign-off, $10k reserved for extension.
2) Discount gating: 30% off first year applies only if Aurora signs a 12-month contract within 45 days after pilot completion and meets the >=50% usage milestone.
3) Billing channel: Discount applies only to direct Redwood billing; reseller exceptions require separate approval.

If you’re aligned I’ll update SOW language and prepare the official approval memo for procurement. Ben — hold on final SOW send until Marissa confirms.

- Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Thanks — I reviewed the numbers and the strategic upside. I approve the exception with the conditions you proposed, plus one addition for risk control: 

- Add a clause that unused credit after the pilot lapse is forfeited unless an extension is formally requested and approved before the pilot end date.

Operational notes: Please run the revised SOW by Legal for the extension language and confirm finance will allow the staged credit draw (Ben, loop finance billing to set up the rebate accounting). Once Legal signs off, Laura — you have my go-ahead to confirm terms to Claire and prepare the pilot SOW for signature.

Marissa
